previousHero720p.prompt:
Create a clean hand-drawn 2D skateboard-pushing animation cycle from this exact image. Camera and all background artwork remain perfectly static. Keep Zoomer, skateboard and cup in their exact original right-side screen position, preserving the open sunset sky on the left for website text. Preserve the original flat colors, crisp black outlines, face, orange hair, glasses, clothing, backpack, camo shoes, cup and board. No motion blur, ghosting, transparent doubles, morphing, 3D, zooms or cuts.

Animate ONE specific motion continuously for eight seconds: a calm repeating skateboard push cycle about every two seconds. The FRONT FOOT is the shoe already resting on the skateboard, at the RIGHT of the image. That shoe must remain completely planted at the same spot on the deck for every frame, with the sole always touching the deck. It never lifts, slides, changes shape or switches with the other foot. The REAR FOOT is the shoe that starts raised behind him, on the LEFT of his body. ONLY that rear foot moves: swing down beside the board, contact the pavement, push backward against the pavement, lift behind the body, then swing forward through the air and repeat. Clear foot-ground contact, a small supporting-knee bend and gentle torso balance. This is skateboarding, with one foot always fixed on the deck; never walking, running, hopping or swapping feet. The board itself remains stable in the exact same position; wheels rotate.

Both arms hold the ORIGINAL pose throughout: the cup stays upright at the original height in the original single hand, while the free arm stays down behind the hip. No arm swing across the body, no reaching for the drink, no grip changes, no sipping, waving or looking around. Two arms, two legs, one rider. The rhythmic rear-leg push repeats naturally at least four times from the very first frame through the final frame without any pause, glide hold, stop, final pose or reset. Movement is already ongoing at the beginning and continues beyond the end. Silent.

source.quality_qualification: The 3840x2160 master is the existing AI-upscaled hero source, not newly generated native 4K artwork. Its static body and shoe are directly resampled to the final2K canvas. No temporal neural interpolation is used for the active hero.

matte.method: 4K sourceRGB fromexactframe120. Existing1280×720SAMalpha scaled3×Lanczos; source-frame alignment matches pose1. Bodyrearlegcut sameasbase. Realcuff boundary tracedat4K: shincontainsgraycloth/blackcuffedgeonly, shoecontainscamo+whitecollar andsubpixelblackseamoverlap, noremnantpantsliver. geometry.method: Continuous vector trouser silhouette and folds, original4K rigid shoe and fixed body

articulation.path: Piecewise cubic Hermite ankle path using knot positions and velocities; matching endpoint position/velocity gives C1 periodic continuity. Sample at f/60 for f0..59.
articulation.knee: Two-bone inverse kinematics with fixed lengths115 and110; negative-cross knee branch retained.
articulation.cloth: Fill thigh and calf polygons plus a knee disc into one union silhouette before outlining; this avoids independently rotating raster seams and fold-over outlines. Smooth silhouette with Gaussian sigma1.8*S and threshold127. Add sparse curved folds and a single hip attachment hidden beneath the fixed body.
articulation.shoe: Original4K shoe is a rigid affine rotation and translation with uniform output scaling; no shear, mesh deformation or frame-to-frame shape generation.
articulation.shoe_angle: Hold -81deg through0.27s, then C1 smoothstep to-15deg by0.42s; later angle knots are recorded in geometry.knots.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Seamless horizontally repeating 2D background clean plate for an animated skateboard website hero.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND PALETTE reference only: match its exact hand-drawn black outline comic style, sunset palette, matte cel colours, shallow side-view perspective and low horizon. Generate a fresh scenery plate with NO character, skateboard, drink, person, cast shadow, text, logos, or vehicles.
Scene: a long empty city skatepark panorama at golden sunset. Warm apricot and persimmon sky with muted mauve simple horizontal cloud bands and a small low warm sun. Far purple city skyline, muted sage and deep olive trees, continuous fine black metal railing. Shallow concrete ramps and low ledges are in the middle distance; the lower 25 percent is unobstructed flat warm concrete pavement with a few fine surface lines. No large close half-pipes and no tall objects obstructing the foreground.
Composition: WIDE horizontal full scene, ideally 2:1 or 16:9, high resolution, 2K detail. Top 55 percent is open sunset sky. Tallest skyline and foliage begin around 45 percent of canvas height. Park base is around 78 percent. Ground is a continuous horizontal plane, seen from the same low side view as the reference. This background will scroll to the left behind a stationary animated skateboard rider.
CRITICAL TILE CONSTRAINT: design this as a seamless horizontal repeating panorama: left and right canvas edges must join invisibly when repeated side by side. The horizon, rail, pavement height, sky colours and cloud bands continue cleanly across both edges. Keep edge geometry simple and exactly aligned, not large cropped side ramps. No fade to white, no border, no vignette. Clean crisp irregular black linework and flat cel colouring, finely drawn yet matte, absolutely 2D and never 3D or photorealistic.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: horizontally repeatable 2D skateboard game background clean plate.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve this exact full hand-drawn sunset skatepark artwork, no people, matte warm orange sky, purple skyline, olive trees, continuous rail and concrete ground. Make only the changes needed to turn it into a SEAMLESS HORIZONTAL TILE.
Critical: when the finished rectangle is repeated left to right, the left and right edges must join invisibly. The top sky, cloud bands, horizon, railings, tree mass and all pavement lines need exactly matching colours and heights at both sides. Keep the narrow left and right edge zones simple: identical empty coral sky with NO clouds touching the edges in the upper half, low level olive trees and horizontal black rail at the SAME y-coordinate on both edges, matching flat warm concrete from rail base down. Remove the raised corner ramps currently cut off on the sides and replace them with matching low concrete ledges of exactly the same height at left and right. The central composition and low sunset sun can remain. The lower 25 percent stays open flat pavement. No fade, border or vignette. No new character, objects, text, logos or 3D. This is a wide 2.5:1 panoramic side-scrolling background. Output crisp high resolution around 2560 pixels wide.

background_generation.verification: No people, rider, board, drink or cast shadow. Crisp flat 2D linework. Corrected version keeps clouds away from both side edges and matches rail/lowledge heights; use mirrored tile pairs if perfect numerical edge continuity is required.

sky_edit.prompt:

Input image 1 is the edit target. Preserve the EXACT existing warm apricot sunset sky gradient, its colours, every mauve and gold cloud shape, and the low central sun at precisely the SAME normalized position and SAME scale. Keep the existing wide 2.5:1 panoramic framing.
Change only the scenery below the sky: completely remove ALL city skyline buildings, trees, plants, fences, railings, concrete ramps, ledges and pavement. Replace their area by a seamless downward extension of the same orange apricot sunset sky. Restore the unobstructed complete circular sun and existing horizontal sunset cloud bands in the lower center, preserving its original center around x51%, y63% and its original diameter around 6.3% of image width. The sun and upper cloud shapes must not move or grow.
The full image is sky only, from edge to edge, with absolutely no ground, water, silhouettes, horizon objects, character, skateboard, vehicle, people, new props or text. Match the original exactly: flat matte 2D comic painted sky, clean edges, no3D, no photorealism, no glow bloom. Preserve all existing upper sky and clouds pixel-composition as faithfully as possible. Lower image remains the same saturated warm orange sky rather than pale fog. This is a separate static sky layer for the existing image. Output wide horizontal high resolution.
sky_edit.verification: Sky-only. Existing cloud shapes and sun normalized location retained, no scenery silhouettes remain. No people or props.

world_segmentation.method: Connected warm-sunset color matte with top-connected flood labels; no box clipping through skyline; preserve all cool mauve buildings and dark foliage outlines; fully transparent above390; force opaque below580; no rescale or RGB changes.

background.direction: Linear leftward; mirrored artwork provides repeating edge continuity without reversing camera travel.

result.active_curve: Applied delayed release -81deg through0.27s, then smoothstep to-15deg by0.42s; original ankle Hermite curve retained.

pass_criteria.reachability: All sampled ankle radii strictly within the two-bone reach interval.
pass_criteria.contact_velocity: Every planted sample matches moving pavement -320px/s horizontally and0 vertically.
pass_criteria.periodic_continuity: Position, velocity, angle and angular velocity match at t0 andt1.

applied_reverification.fringe_qualification: Very low-opacity alpha>1 fringe retains the same static2.686px extent beyond the opaque sole. Alpha>32 remains within0.711px; the visible8px motion penetration is removed.

limitations: Projection extrema use convex hulls of all shoe pixels above each stated alpha threshold, equivalent to testing the full rigid rotated mask for y extent.
The source raster is resampled by warpAffine during rendering. Raster antialiasing can add a subpixel fringe beyond projected pixel centers.
This verifies ground clearance and continuity mathematically; rendering still needs visual inspection for clothing silhouette, cuff overlap, and animation appeal.
contact_audit.fringe_qualification: Very low-opacity alpha>1 fringe retains the same static2.686px extent beyond the opaque sole. Alpha>32 remains within0.711px; the visible8px motion penetration is removed.

delivery_checks.decode: All960frames decoded with ffmpeg; exit0, no diagnostics

final_geometry_review.sole_measurement: Every pixel with alpha above 0.8 in the unchanged source shoe is rigidly rotated and translated using the updated 2K cycle metadata; positions are normalized to the 1280 x 720 coordinate basis.

visual_review.findings: The sole stays on the pavement through 13 contact frames. The foot lifts before rotating downward, clears the ground, recovers forward and lands. Every reviewed cuff remains closed. Shoe texture and shape remain rigid. No extra foot, broken ankle, detached cuff or reversing knee bend was observed. The simpler cloth styling is deliberate.
visual_review.scope_limit: The four-second preview does not wrap. This review does not approve the 16-second world seam, production browser playback or deployment.

renditions2k.policy: Final delivery 2560x1440 for wide hero and 2048x2048 for square artwork/video. Higher-resolution intermediate processing masters are excluded from deployment. Only referenced files ship.
